capabilities: export the current note to Word, PDF, HTML, EPUB, LaTeX and other Pandoc formats
expand embeds and transclusions recursively before conversion
process citations by passing --citeproc with a configured .bib file and CSL style
configure output folders and extra Pandoc arguments in settings
bind each export format to a hotkey via commands
extras: Desktop only, since the plugin runs the Pandoc executable; explains how it uses process-execution and filesystem permissions and states it makes no network requests; accepts donations via PayPal and Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Exporting a note through Pandoc requires running the tool manually with the right arguments; Obsidian has no built-in way to convert notes to formats like docx or EPUB.

relations.evidence: One-click buttons that export the current note to Word, PDF, HTML, EPUB, LaTeX, and any other format Pandoc supports

requires.name: PDF engine (tectonic, xelatex, typst, or wkhtmltopdf)

summary: Adds one-click sidebar buttons and commands that export the current note to Word, PDF, HTML, EPUB, LaTeX and other Pandoc formats.
